name: authenticated-scripts
description: Azure DevOps task for running scripts with Generic service-connection credentials.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-task-version.mts && tsc --project tsconfig.json && esbuild build/tasks/AuthenticatedScripts/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=tasks/AuthenticatedScripts/dist/index.js && node build/scripts/copy-task-resources.js && npm run build:logo
scripts.package:raw: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path build/authenticated-scripts.vsix
scripts.package: npm run package:raw && node build/scripts/repack-vsix.js build/authenticated-scripts.vsix
